AmielJohn.title: The Caloric Warlord
AmielJohn.lore: Legend says AmielJohn's hunger once collapsed a dungeon's economy by eating all the loot drops. Invented 'Snack Diplomacy' — a foreign policy where enemies are bribed with jerky. The Cold Snack War with M1ssy has escalated into full-blown Snack Embargo — LXRDGRIM mediates on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and emergency Saturdays. Goblok appointed him Supply General; supplies vanished in 8 minutes (new record). Recently formed an alliance with PotatoCheese called 'The Carb Axis' — it's delicious and terrifying. His battle cry is still just aggressive chewing, but louder.
AmielJohn.reputation: The only member who treats boss raids like competitive eating contests
AmielJohn.stats: Hunger 9999 | Snack Hoarding 500 | Digestion Speed 0.3 | Treaty Violations 89 | Carb Allies 1

Azryth.title: The Nightlight Ninja
Azryth.lore: Named after Azrael, the Angel of Death — except this one carries a Hello Kitty nightlight into assassinations. Wrote a 300-page thesis titled 'Why Darkness is Overrated (A Manifesto)' while hiding from his own shadow. LXRDGRIM now charges him premium therapy rates. Once failed an assassination because he stopped to debate the target about Nietzsche — the target joined Elysium AND now co-hosts a philosophy podcast with him. His nightlight collection has grown to 73. Byakko relates to him on a spiritual level (both are divine disappointments).
Azryth.reputation: Death's most anxious apprentice with award-winning podcast
Azryth.stats: Stealth 95 | Darkness Phobia 999 | Philosophy 300 | Nightlight Collection 73 | Podcast Listeners 12K

Byakko.title: The Squeaking Guardian Deity
Byakko.lore: The legendary White Tiger of the West, whose divine roar once split mountains. Now it sounds like a dog toy being stepped on. Genbu, Suzaku, and Seiryu blocked him on all celestial platforms AND created a group chat without him called 'Real Guardians Only.' His 'intimidation roar' caused an enemy army to adopt him as their emotional support mascot. Currently suing five kingdoms for using his squeak as their morning alarm tone — he's won 2 cases purely from pity. Recently bonded with Azryth over mutual divine disappointment. The mountains he guards have started a GoFundMe for his vocal training.
Byakko.reputation: Heaven's most embarrassing guardian deity with successful lawsuits
Byakko.stats: Divine Power 999 | Roar Volume 2 | Cuteness Factor ILLEGAL | Celestial Credibility -800 | Lawsuits Won 2

Carrera.title: The Supersonic Latecomer
Carrera.lore: Named after the Porsche Carrera — fastest thing on wheels. Somehow always 3 hours late. Has broken the sound barrier 89 times trying to be punctual; still missed every boss spawn. Einstein's paper 'The Carrera Paradox' is now taught in universities. Once ran so fast he arrived at yesterday's raid AND tomorrow's raid simultaneously — attended neither. The guild invented 'Carrera Time' (3 hours before actual time) — he's still late. Onirgerep tried to help with reverse strategy; they both arrived in the wrong dimension. Physicists want to study him. He's too late for the appointments.
Carrera.specialty: Breaking physics to achieve perfect tardiness
Carrera.reputation: Proof that speed and punctuality exist in separate universes
Carrera.stats: Speed ∞ | Punctuality -999 | Time Crimes 347 | Excuses Per Second 75 | Dimensions Confused 2

CheeseCakee.title: The Lactose Martyr
CheeseCakee.lore: A dessert weaponsmith who is violently allergic to their own creations. Every cheesecake is a suicide mission. Enemies can't tell if the screaming is a battle cry or gastrointestinal distress — tactical advantage confirmed. Has a PLATINUM sponsorship deal with four epipen companies and is featured in their commercials. The Geneva Convention added THREE new clauses about their 'Explosive Tiramisu.' Inihaw permanently banned them from the guild kitchen after 'The Second Incident' (the first was bad enough). Recently formed the 'Allergy Brigade' with M1ssy, PanCoco, and Hayacinth — their meetings require paramedics on standby.
CheeseCakee.reputation: The sweetest war crime with corporate sponsorship
CheeseCakee.stats: Baking 300 | Lactose Tolerance -999 | Pain Threshold YES | Hospital Bills ∞ | Sponsorships 4

Chunchunmaru.title: The Legendary Meme Blade
Chunchunmaru.lore: Wields a sword named 'Chunchunmaru' — a name so ridiculous that Kazuma himself would weep with pride. Enemies laugh themselves into defeat. Applied for legendary weapon registration THREE times; was denied because the entire registration office couldn't stop giggling. The sword has higher meme value than actual damage AND an active fan community. Once defeated a dragon because it choked on its own laughter. Refuses to rename it 'for strategic purposes.' DadaXxD made him into a meme format — it went viral. The strategy is comedy. The comedy is lethal. The merch sales are profitable.
Chunchunmaru.specialty: Psychological warfare through aggressive naming conventions
Chunchunmaru.reputation: The reason enemy morale reports include 'death by comedy' and fan art
Chunchunmaru.stats: Sword Power 150 | Name Dignity -999 | Comedy Damage 9999 | Straight Face 0 | Meme Formats 7

Daleee.title: The Inverse Catastrophe
Daleee.lore: A mage whose extra E's represent extra errors. Casts healing on enemies, fireballs on allies, and once accidentally granted a boss immortality (the boss is now a guild accountant — best mistake ever). The guild weaponized 'Daleee Logic' — aim at what you don't want to hit. Successfully saved a siege by trying to surrender. His spellbook is written backwards, upside down, in a language he invented by mistake, AND it somehow got published as a bestseller. Scholars study his notes as 'Anti-Magic Theory' — it's now a university major. Carrera tried to use his inverse logic for punctuality. They created a temporal paradox. It was Tuesday.
Daleee.specialty: Achieving correct results through maximum wrongness
Daleee.reputation: The wizard who became a published author by failing
Daleee.stats: Spell Accuracy 100% (Inverted) | Intended Results 0 | Accidental Saves 1247 | Bestsellers 1 | Paradoxes Created 1

Enaira.title: The Walking Economic Disaster
Enaira.lore: Named after Nigeria's eNaira — a digital currency so failed it made regular failure look successful. Every transaction Enaira touches crashes harder than Hesucrypto's portfolio (they're forbidden from trading together). Once bankrupted an enemy guild by sending them 1 gold — they're still in debt. The Central Banks of nine kingdoms have her wanted poster. Somehow the guild treasury GAINS money when she's around because the economy breaks in their favor. Economists cry when writing papers about her. She has her own economic index called 'The Enaira Effect.' It's taught in business schools as a warning. Hesucrypto wants to hire her. LXRDGRIM says no.
Enaira.specialty: Collapsing financial systems by existing near them
Enaira.reputation: The economic anomaly with a stock market index
Enaira.stats: Transaction Success 0% | Economic Destruction ∞ | Pity Donations 9999 | Wanted Level 9 KINGDOMS | Economic Indexes 1

erwarrr.title: The Glitched Silence
erwarrr.lore: Name sounds like a keyboard error because he IS a keyboard error. A mute mage whose 'screams' are just aggressive silence that makes everyone uncomfortable. Once cleared a room by not saying anything for 89 minutes straight — it's now a guild record. His silent choir performs at funerals — the funerals of his enemies. Communicates entirely through ominous eyebrow movements AND interpretive staring. Even his typos are silent. Recently had a 'conversation' with Miang — she talked for 6 hours while he stared. They both claim it was productive. Nobody understands. His silence has been weaponized into a meditation app — it's rated 1 star for being 'too uncomfortable.' It works perfectly.
erwarrr.reputation: The error message with a meditation app
erwarrr.stats: Volume 0 | Awkwardness 9999 | Eyebrow Eloquence 300 | Uncomfortable Silences Per Minute 89 | App Downloads 50K

Evand3r.title: The Spoon Knight
Evand3r.lore: Named like a warrior, fights like a kitchen. Once slew a titan with a spoon — THE legendary spoon. Lost it AGAIN. Now every raid is also a spoon quest AND a Netflix documentary series. Has defeated enemies with: coffee mugs, staplers, a very aggressive sandwich, someone else's shoe, and a commemorative plate from Riku's keychain collection. The spoon has achieved Holy Grail status. Evand3r claims it's 'definitely in a boss's inventory this time.' Every boss inventory is meticulously checked for legendary utensils. The documentary is in its third season. The spoon is still missing. Viewers are invested.
Evand3r.reputation: The hero with a Netflix series about a missing spoon
Evand3r.stats: Improvisation ∞ | Spoon Location UNKNOWN | Objects Weaponized 12000 | Actual Weapons Used 3 | TV Seasons 3

Fever.title: The Organized Apocalypse
Fever.lore: Embodies chaos but files it alphabetically. While reality collapses, Fever is color-coding the debris. Has labeled the void. The void is now organized AND has subsections. Enemies lose sanity watching catastrophe being sorted by category. Hosts 'Apocalypse Filing' workshops — they're fully booked 6 months in advance. Goblok once asked for a strategy; Fever delivered a 97-tab spreadsheet of doom with pivot tables and conditional formatting. The spreadsheet was beautiful. The doom was organized. The enemy general surrendered just to see the final presentation. It had animations.
Fever.reputation: The only member whose chaos comes with professional presentations
Fever.stats: Chaos Level ∞ | Organization ∞ | Labels Used 15000 | Sanity (Others') 0 | Workshops Sold Out YES

Goblok.title: The Glorious Idiot King
Goblok.lore: Name literally means 'stupid' in Indonesian — wears it as a crown AND a philosophy. Every decision defies logic so hard that logic filed a restraining order AND moved to another dimension. Enemies prepare for his stupidity; he out-stupids their preparations into bankruptcy. Declared a 7-day siege 'a speed-nap with spicy dreams.' WON in 4 hours. His battle plans are drawn in crayon, include stick figures, AND have coffee stains as 'strategic markers.' They work flawlessly. Military academies study him as 'What Not To Do (But It Works Anyway)' — it's the most popular course. Fever made his crayon drawings into official strategy documents. Hesucrypto wants to turn his methods into an NFT collection. Goblok said yes without understanding NFTs.
Goblok.reputation: The dumbest genius teaching at military academies
Goblok.stats: IQ ??? | Logic 0 | Victory Rate 99.7% | Sense Made 0 | University Courses 1 | NFT Interest 1

Helvenica.title: The Comic Sans Crusader
Helvenica.lore: Named after Helvetica font but fights exclusively in Comic Sans — the ultimate betrayal. Graphic designers worldwide formed a support group because of her; it now has 3,000 members across 12 countries. Every attack is formatted in the most hated font. Enemies die from design horror before the damage lands. Maintains the 'Hall of Bad Typography' as a war memorial AND tourist attraction (admission: 5 gold). Once kerned someone to death. The kerning was awful. So was the death. So was the memorial plaque (also in Comic Sans). Recently fought using Papyrus — three designers required hospitalization. She's banned from design conferences but shows up anyway. The security guards just cry.
Helvenica.reputation: The reason design schools teach combat typography as mandatory
Helvenica.stats: Typography 999 | Taste -∞ | Designer Casualties 12000 | Comic Sans Usage MAXIMUM | Tourist Revenue 5000 GOLD

Hercules.title: The Divine Couch Potato
Hercules.lore: Son of Zeus, blessed with godlike strength. Uses it exclusively to reach the remote without getting up. Rejected all 12 labors, claiming each was 'the 13th labor in disguise, actually.' Zeus has stopped calling AND blocked his number. His legendary strength has carried: snacks, other people's responsibilities, exactly zero heroic quests, AND AmielJohn's snack supply once (it was heavy). Once lifted a mountain to get better WiFi signal. The WiFi was worth it. The heroism wasn't. Recently started a YouTube channel called 'Godlike Couch Reviews' — it has 2 million subscribers. Zeus watched one episode and cried. Hera subscribed.
Hercules.specialty: God-tier strength applied to maximum laziness
Hercules.reputation: Olympus's greatest disappointment with a successful YouTube channel
Hercules.stats: Strength GODLIKE | Labors Completed 0 | Excuses Invented ∞ | Couch Time 15000 HOURS | YouTube Subs 2M

Hesucrypto.title: The Broke Billionaire
Hesucrypto.lore: Made millions. Lost millions. Made millions again. Lost it faster. Currently owns NFTs of his own debt AND Goblok's crayon strategies (pending). Created the Jalo Bot as 'the only profitable thing in my life besides copium.' Gives motivational speeches that start with 'diamond hands' and end with 'we're spiritually wealthy, kings.' The guild treasury runs on his vibes and Enaira's inverse economy. Predicted 73 market crashes — was right about 71 — invested in the 72nd AND 73rd anyway because 'the vibe was immaculate.' Enaira is forbidden from touching anything he touches by guild law Section 7, Subsection 'Financial Apocalypse Prevention.' They're considering a joint podcast. LXRDGRIM is pre-writing the therapy notes.
Hesucrypto.specialty: Turning financial ruin into motivational content
Hesucrypto.reputation: The richest broke person with pending NFT deals
Hesucrypto.stats: Net Worth VIBES | Actual Money -15000 | NFT Collection 'PRICELESS' | Copium ∞ | Podcast Pitches 1

Iguro.title: The Portal Disaster
Iguro.lore: Named after the Snake Pillar — graceful, precise, deadly. Opens portals like a drunk GPS having an existential crisis. Aimed for the enemy throne room, arrived in Inihaw's BBQ mid-flip (the ribs were ruined — war crime). Five boss monsters joined Elysium because Iguro teleported them into the welcome party. Has a spreadsheet titled 'Accidental Recruits (Excellent PR Strategy Actually).' The enemy's best infiltration defense is hoping Iguro tries to send reinforcements — he'll send them to the wrong dimension, wrong timeline, AND occasionally underwater. Carrera tried to race through one of his portals. They both ended up in last week. Onirgerep felt validated.
Iguro.specialty: Dimensional dysfunction with recruitment side effects
Iguro.reputation: The worst navigator with the best accidental HR record
Iguro.stats: Portal Accuracy 0% | Recruitment Rate 999% | Dimensions Confused ∞ | GPS Trust -9999 | Underwater Incidents 7

Inihaw.title: The Vegan BBQ Warlord
Inihaw.lore: Name literally means 'grilled' in Filipino — is vegan. The cognitive dissonance is his weapon AND his brand. Wields a greatsword-spatula hybrid that's seen more combat than most armies. Lectures about plant-based diets while grilling enemies to perfection. Once defended a fortress using smoked ribs as psychological warfare (they were tofu — the enemy didn't know until after surrendering). The war crime tribunal is STILL deciding if it was delicious or illegal. Probably both. Has banned CheeseCakee AND Iguro from his kitchen. CheeseCakee for obvious reasons. Iguro for teleporting enemies mid-flip. Recently published a cookbook titled 'Vegan Violence.' It's a bestseller. The recipes work. The violence is metaphorical (mostly).
Inihaw.specialty: Contradictory culinary combat & moral confusion damage
Inihaw.reputation: The vegan defender with a bestselling violence cookbook
Inihaw.stats: Grilling 9999 | Veganism 9999 | Hypocrisy TACTICAL | Enemies Grilled (Ethically?) ??? | Cookbooks 1

Jalo.title: The Patron Saint of Wrong
Jalo.lore: So legendarily incorrect that Hesucrypto named a bot after him — the bot is the only accurate thing associated with his name AND makes more money than both of them. Once convinced a dragon that flossing prevents fire breath. THE DRAGON BELIEVED HIM and now has excellent dental hygiene. His 'facts' are weapons of mass confusion certified by three kingdoms. Goblok consults him for advice — this explains EVERYTHING about Goblok's success rate. The Jalo Bot exists as proof that incorrectness can be automated into profit. Recently started a 'Facts' YouTube channel — every fact is wrong, has 500K subscribers, AND an educational partnership (they don't know it's wrong). Daleee watches it religiously.
Jalo.specialty: Tactical misinformation delivered with perfect confidence
Jalo.reputation: The encyclopedia of things that aren't true but work anyway
Jalo.stats: Fact Accuracy 0% | Confidence 9999 | Dragons Convinced 1 | Bot Revenue PROFIT | YouTube Subs 500K

Jayzzzzzzz.title: The Insomniac Berserker
Jayzzzzzzz.lore: The Z's in his name represent all the sleep he hasn't gotten. Fights in a state of caffeinated psychosis that doctors study. Has unlocked 'Snooze-Chi' — a forbidden technique that turns exhaustion into violence AND a power source. Frequently naps mid-battle and STILL lands finishing moves during REM sleep. Once sleepwalked through an entire raid — top DPS AND best positioning. The guild has 'Jayz Watch' to prevent heroic sleepwalking incidents (he once sleepwalked into an enemy kingdom and won). His yawns are classified as AOE attacks by the Geneva Convention. Recently started drinking Hesucrypto's 'motivational energy drinks' — his sleep debt is now visible to the naked eye. It's purple. LXRDGRIM is concerned. Jayz hasn't noticed.
Jayzzzzzzz.specialty: Combat efficiency through severe sleep deprivation
Jayzzzzzzz.stats: Sleep Debt ∞ | Energy UNKNOWN | Sleepwalk Kills 15000 | Caffeine Blood Level 99.9% | Visible Sleep Debt YES

JeffEpstein.title: The Nominative Nightmare
JeffEpstein.lore: The name causes instant awkward silence in any room. Is somehow the nicest person in existence. Bakes cookies for orphans. Rescues stray familiars. Donates to charity. The cognitive dissonance is so strong that enemies blue-screen trying to process it. Nobody questions the name when the orphanage is fed and the cookies are THIS good. HR has given up AND nominated him for 'Member of the Month' four times (he won twice). The cookies are really good. Really, really good. Recently opened a bakery called 'Cookies of Redemption' — the name didn't help but the cookies did. Has a 5-star rating despite everything. ladyhoho works there part-time. The laughter is concerning but the pastries are immaculate.
JeffEpstein.reputation: The nicest person with the worst possible name and a bakery
JeffEpstein.stats: Kindness 9999 | Name Controversy ∞ | Cookies Baked 20000 | Questions Asked 0 | Bakery Rating 5 STARS

ladyhoho.title: The Laughing Depression
ladyhoho.lore: The 'hoho' is both her laugh and her emotional support sound. Smiles through trauma like it's a competitive sport (she's ranked internationally). Her laugh is a battlefield weapon — enemies can't tell if it's joy or a cry for help. Neither can she. LXRDGRIM has her on speed dial AND emergency speed dial AND 'please check on her' speed dial. Has converted existential dread into a combo multiplier AND a part-time job at JeffEpstein's bakery. Once laughed an enemy army into an uncomfortable retreat. They sent a therapist as tribute. She laughed through the therapy session. The therapist is now her friend. They laugh together. It's concerning. Works at 'Cookies of Redemption' — customers describe her energy as 'troubling yet wholesome.'
ladyhoho.reputation: The happiest tragedy working at a redemption bakery
ladyhoho.stats: Laughter ∞ | Actual Joy 5 | Coping Mechanisms 12000 | Therapy Sessions Needed MANY | Bakery Hours 20/WEEK

LXRDGRIM.title: The Therapeutic Edgelord
LXRDGRIM.lore: The edgiest name in the guild attached to a certified therapist with THREE additional licenses now. His scythe has an 'EMOTIONAL SUPPORT' sticker AND a therapy certification seal. Provides therapy to: Azryth (darkness phobia + podcast anxiety), ladyhoho (everything + bakery stress), Hesucrypto (financial delusion), and 47% of the enemy army (they surrender for sliding-scale life advice). His brooding is professionally required AND tax-deductible. Files 'Emotional Incident Reports' after every battle AND publishes them in peer-reviewed journals. The most wholesome death entity in existence with a waiting list. Recently started a group therapy session called 'Elysium Anonymous' — attendance is mandatory for AmielJohn, M1ssy, and anyone who talks to Jalo. It's Tuesdays and Thursdays. Fridays are for emergency interventions (usually Hesucrypto).
LXRDGRIM.specialty: Intimidation that comes with a therapy session
LXRDGRIM.reputation: Death's friendliest representative with published research
LXRDGRIM.stats: Brooding 9999 | Therapy Skill 9999 | Scythe Hugs Given 15000 | Edge (Actual) 100 | Licenses 3

M1ssy.title: The Anaphylactic Anarchist
M1ssy.lore: Allergic to literally everything she eats. Eats everything anyway. Her epipen has a killstreak counter AND a loyalty program. Currently in a snack Cold War with AmielJohn that has evolved into 'Snack Détente' (they share sometimes, paramedics on standby). LXRDGRIM mediates on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and emergency Saturdays (there are many). Once used an allergic reaction as a distraction to win a siege — won 'Tactical Innovation Award' from Goblok (it's a crayon drawing). Medical professionals weep at her dietary choices. Her snack sharing with AmielJohn has caused seven diplomatic incidents. She's undefeated in allergy roulette. Commander of the 'Allergy Brigade' alongside CheeseCakee, PanCoco, and Hayacinth — their formation requires three ambulances.
M1ssy.reputation: The only member whose lunch is a strategic decision
M1ssy.stats: Allergies ALL | Snack Dedication 9999 | Epipen Uses ∞ | Medical Advice Ignored 100% | Awards 1 (CRAYON)

Maria.title: The Incorrectly Victorious Twin
Maria.lore: Marsha11's twin who wins every argument by being louder, not righter. Has never been correct about anything. Wins anyway. Once convinced an enemy guild their own banner was an insult — they retreated to consult their flags AND changed the design. Her 'facts' are weapons of mass confidence certified by zero sources. Marsha11 has spreadsheets proving her wrong; Maria just yells over them AND the spreadsheets. The spreadsheets cry. Maria doesn't notice. Recently won an argument with Fever's organized spreadsheet — Fever is still processing how. The debate was archived as 'The Impossible Victory.' Scholars study it. Maria thinks they're studying her genius. They're studying the paradox.
Maria.specialty: Victory through volume & confidence over correctness
Maria.reputation: The twin who wins by not listening AND breaks spreadsheets
Maria.stats: Volume 9999 | Accuracy 0 | Arguments Won 15000 | Arguments Deserved to Win 0 | Impossible Victories 1

Marsha11.title: The Eternally Correct Loser
Marsha11.lore: Maria's twin who loses every argument despite being objectively right. Has spreadsheets. Has evidence. Has witnesses. Has a PhD in Being Right (nobody listens). Maria just says 'no' louder. Has documented proof of being right 14,999 times. Has won 3 arguments total. All three were when Maria was asleep AND in a different kingdom. The guild uses her archives as official historical records. Maria's version becomes official anyway. Frustration is her primary stat AND fuel source. Recently tried to debate Fever's organized apocalypse — lost because Maria interrupted. Fever felt bad and gave her a perfectly organized filing system for her frustrations. It's color-coded by 'Ways Maria Is Wrong But Wins.' It's 47 volumes.
Marsha11.specialty: Being right in a world that rewards wrong
Marsha11.reputation: The most accurate member nobody listens to with a PhD
Marsha11.stats: Accuracy 9999 | Wins 3 | Evidence Ignored ∞ | Frustration MAXIMUM | PhD 1 | Filing Volumes 47

Miang.title: The Verbal Avalanche
Miang.lore: Claims to be 'the silent type.' Has not stopped talking since joining. Enemies surrender just to make it stop. Holds workshops called 'How To Achieve Silence (Through Infinite Words)' — they're 8 hours long and VERY popular among enemies who want to retire. Once talked an enemy to sleep, then to death, then the corpse somehow looked tired. Her monologues have been classified as AOE crowd control AND a form of torture by the Geneva Convention. erwarrr is her only natural counter — they cancel each other out into uncomfortable staring (Miang talks, erwarrr stares, universe balances). Recently had a 12-hour 'conversation' with herself — won the argument on both sides. DadaXxD tried to communicate with her using memes. She explained each meme in essay format. He hasn't sent memes since.
Miang.reputation: The 'quiet one' who never shuts up and wins self-arguments
Miang.stats: Words Per Minute ∞ | Silence 0 | Enemy Attention Span DESTROYED | Breath Control GODLIKE | Self-Arguments Won 2

Munchyy.title: The Courteous Killer
Munchyy.lore: An assassin who sends handwritten apology notes with every kill. The handwriting is illegible — enemies die confused but appreciated. Studied calligraphy under a master who was also illiterate (Jalo's recommendation). Her 'Sorry Notes' are collector's items worth more than the bounties AND are sold at auctions. Has accidentally created an assassination art movement called 'Apologetic Death.' The etiquette is flawless. The penmanship is criminal. The kills are immaculate. Recently opened an Etsy shop for her apology notes — 5-star reviews, nobody can read them, everyone loves them anyway. Marsha11 tried to correct her handwriting. Maria yelled that it's perfect. Munchyy's penmanship got worse somehow.
Munchyy.reputation: The only assassin with an Etsy shop and 5-star reviews
Munchyy.stats: Etiquette 9999 | Handwriting -9999 | Kill Politeness ∞ | Note Collectors 200 | Etsy Sales 1000+

Onirgerep.title: The Backwards Enigma
Onirgerep.lore: Name is 'Peregrine' backwards — does EVERYTHING backwards. Retreats forward. Charges in reverse. Reads maps upside down and still arrives first (yesterday). Once surrendered at the START of a battle, then ambushed during the victory celebration — the celebration was theirs. His strategies are reverse psychology made manifest AND taught at military academies as 'Advanced Backwards Theory.' Allies are confused. Enemies are confused. He's confused too, but it's working. Tried to help Carrera with punctuality using reverse time — they both ended up in last week AND next month simultaneously. Daleee thinks he's a genius. Onirgerep thinks Daleee is backwards. They're both right and wrong. Fever documented it in reverse chronological order.
Onirgerep.reputation: The man who wins by doing everything wrong-way-round
Onirgerep.stats: Forward Movement NEGATIVE | Reverse Wins 12000 | Confusion (Self) YES | Confusion (Others) YES | Time Crimes 2

PotatoCheese.title: The Carbohydrate Martyr
PotatoCheese.lore: Creates the most magnificent potato dishes in existence. Is on permanent keto. Cannot eat anything they make. The irony sustains them more than food ever could. Feeds the entire guild while slowly starving. Their sacrifice is legend AND documented by Marsha11. Nutritionists from five kingdoms have tried to stage interventions. The potatoes are too good. The tragedy is too real. Their tears are seasoning. Formed 'The Carb Axis' with AmielJohn — PotatoCheese cooks, AmielJohn eats, both are happy in their respective suffering and joy. Recently won 'Ironist of the Year' (presented by Inihaw, the vegan griller). The award ceremony was held at a bakery. PotatoCheese cried. The tears improved the bread.
PotatoCheese.specialty: Feeding others what they cannot consume
PotatoCheese.reputation: The chef who dies for their carbs and won an award for it
PotatoCheese.stats: Potato Mastery ∞ | Carbs Eaten 0 | Self-Sacrifice 9999 | Irony Sustenance 100% | Awards 1

Riku.title: The Keyless Keyblade Master
Riku.lore: Named after THE Riku from Kingdom Hearts. Lost the Keyblade. LOST IT. Now carries 73 regular keys and hopes one works. Uses them as a jangling weapon that opens wrong doors at wrong times. Once accidentally unlocked a demon's diary — it now writes Elysium fanfiction AND has 50K followers. Kingdom Hearts lore says he's 'on a side quest.' The side quest has lasted four years. The Keyblade is probably under a couch somewhere. Tried using Evand3r's spoon as a replacement — didn't work but made a great lockpick. Recently found a key that opens Iguro's portals manually — it still goes to the wrong dimension but NOW he can close them. Progress. The demon's fanfiction won an award. Riku is a supporting character.
Riku.specialty: Key-based combat without the right key
Riku.reputation: The chosen one who chose to lose his weapon but gained portal access
Riku.stats: Keys Owned 73 | Correct Key 0 | Destiny Status DELAYED | Demons Unlocked 1 | Fanfic Followers 50K

Shawty.title: The Towering 'Short' King
Shawty.lore: Called 'Shawty' despite being 6'9" (grew an inch). Insists they're being underestimated. Enemies look UP and feel confused. Once hid under a rug during stealth mission — emerged like a floor boss. Doorframes are their natural enemy AND fear them. The delusion is so strong it creates a perception filter verified by scientists (they published a paper). Short energy in a tall body. The cognitive dissonance does psychic damage. Recently walked through a low doorway without ducking — destroyed the doorframe, claimed they 'felt it coming.' Byakko relates to them on a divine disappointment level. They formed the 'Misunderstood Guardians Club.' It's them two and Azryth. They meet under doorframes (Shawty has to crouch).
Shawty.reputation: The 'small' giant nobody saw coming (they should've looked up)
Shawty.stats: Height 6'9" | Perceived Height 4'2" | Doorframe Casualties ∞ | Underestimation BELIEVED | Scientific Papers 1

Skadushy.title: The Photosynthetic Shadow Eater
Skadushy.lore: Eats shadows for breakfast. Runs on sunlight. Both. Simultaneously. Biologists formed a support group, then a research team, then a university department. Breaks every law of thermodynamics before lunch AND rewrites them by dinner. Has a subscription to 'Impossible Biology Monthly' — he's the centerfold AND contributing editor. Once ate his own shadow during an eclipse — Scientists sent a strongly-worded letter. He ate the letter's shadow too. The letter is now transparent. Physics is merely a suggestion. Recently photosynthesized in complete darkness 'for the vibes.' lanZ6 confirmed the vibes were immaculate. Scientists are questioning their degrees. Skadushy is questioning why scientists question things instead of just eating shadows.
Skadushy.reputation: The walking contradiction that has a university department
Skadushy.stats: Shadow Diet YES | Solar Power YES | Biology Logic NONE | Thermodynamics Broken DAILY | University Depts 1

Varys.title: The Unreliable Whisper
Varys.lore: Named after Game of Thrones' master of whispers. Forgets every secret immediately. Makes up new ones. 60% accuracy because half is fabrication — somehow enough for profitable intelligence. Runs a rumor network called 'The Whisper Web' with paid subscriptions (premium tier available). Enemy spies subscribe. They're getting wrong information. It's wrong enough to be useful. Accidentally spreads true rumors while trying to lie. Journalism hates him AND hired him as a consultant. Recently partnered with Jalo for a 'Facts & Whispers' podcast — every episode is 100% incorrect, has 300K listeners, AND a sponsorship deal with a major news network. They don't know it's wrong. Marsha11 knows. Nobody listens to Marsha11.
Varys.specialty: Intelligence gathering with creative memory gaps
Varys.reputation: The spymaster who can't remember what he's spying on but makes profit
Varys.stats: Secrets Heard 15000 | Secrets Remembered 12 | Fabrications 14988 | Accidental Truth 40% | Podcast Listeners 300K

xSelah.title: The Anti-Pause
xSelah.lore: Named after 'Selah' — a Hebrew musical term meaning 'pause.' Cannot stop moving. Physically incapable of dramatic pauses. Ruins every tense moment with involuntary jazz hands. Theaters hire them to teach comedic timing by demonstrating the opposite (they're banned from 12 theaters but hired by 20 others). Their 'selah' moments are just aggressive fidgeting AND interpretive dance. Once tried meditation; achieved enlightenment through aggressive toe-tapping AND finger-drumming simultaneously. The pause never comes. The motion never stops. Recently tried to help erwarrr with silent communication — resulted in the most uncomfortable pantomime in guild history. Both refuse to acknowledge it happened. Everyone saw it. Fever documented it frame-by-frame. It's labeled 'The Incident We Don't Discuss.'
xSelah.specialty: Destroying dramatic tension through constant movement
xSelah.reputation: The interlude that never inter-stops and ruins theater
xSelah.stats: Pause Ability 0 | Constant Motion ∞ | Jazz Hands Involuntary 100% | Dramatic Timing RUINED | Theater Bans 12

Ztig.title: The Ally-Seeking Marksman
Ztig.lore: Perfect aim. Perfect precision. Exclusively hits allies. His bullets have ally-homing technology that science cannot explain (and refuses to study anymore). Banned from 73 raids — shows up anyway because Goblok keeps inviting him. Enemy guilds have tried to HIRE him against them (it would work — he declined on principle). Has an unofficial 'Helmet Fund' for friendly fire victims — it's fully funded AND has surplus. The guild's armor repair bill is named 'The Ztig Tax.' He's trying his best. His best is terrible for his team. Recently got a bullseye at target practice — hit Carrera who was running by three dimensions away. Iguro's portals couldn't explain it. Physics gave up.
Ztig.specialty: Precision marksmanship with wrong target selection
Ztig.reputation: The reason Elysium invented friendly fire insurance AND surplus
Ztig.stats: Aim 9999 | Allied Targets 100% | Enemy Hits 3 | Bans Ignored 73 | Helmet Fund SURPLUS

PanCoco.title: The Allergic Tropical Warrior
PanCoco.lore: Fights with coconuts. Allergic to coconuts. Fights in a hazmat suit that smells like vacation and impending medical emergency. Once initiated 'coconut diplomacy' with a sea serpent — the serpent needed antihistamines afterward AND filed a complaint. The aesthetic is tropical. The reality is epipen. Has never eaten a coconut. Has thrown 15,000 of them. The dedication is terrifying. The allergies are worse. Member of the 'Allergy Brigade' led by M1ssy — their team formation requires medical evacuation routes. Recently weaponized coconut water as biological warfare (he's allergic to the splash damage). The Geneva Convention added a new clause. It's called 'The PanCoco Protocol.' He framed it.
PanCoco.specialty: Tropical warfare while actively dying from it
PanCoco.reputation: The beach episode that requires military medics
PanCoco.stats: Coconut Mastery ∞ | Coconut Allergy ∞ | Hazmat Dependency 100% | Vacation Vibes LETHAL | Geneva Clauses 1

Ace.title: The Luckless Winner
Ace.lore: Has never won a single bet. Has won every single battle. The universe hates his gambling but loves his combat. Goes all-in on desperation plays that become legendary AND case studies. His coin always lands wrong — except when lives depend on it. Maintains a 'Loss Journal' that reads like a tragic comedy AND is published as 'The Unlucky Chronicles' (bestseller). The guild uses his coin flips for OPPOSITE decision making. It works perfectly. Recently bet against himself in a tournament — lost the bet, won the tournament, broke even emotionally, broke the betting system entirely. Casinos have his picture labeled 'DO NOT ACCEPT BETS FROM THIS MAN (Combat Allowed).' Hesucrypto tried to use him for crypto predictions. The market crashed in fear.
Ace.specialty: Winning through cosmic spite & inverted luck
Ace.reputation: The gambler the universe punishes into victory with published journals
Ace.stats: Gambling Wins 0 | Battle Wins 15000 | Luck NEGATIVE | Cosmic Spite MAXIMUM | Bestsellers 1

Rapadapa.title: The Rhythmic Disaster
Rapadapa.lore: Name sounds like a beatbox. Cannot beatbox. Has no rhythm. The 'rhythm' is controlled chaos that enemies cannot predict AND scholars cannot study. Once defeated an army by clapping off-beat so hard they all tripped in unison — the video went viral, has 5M views. His internal soundtrack is just static and confidence. Dance instructors cry when they see him. His moves are unpredictable because even HE doesn't know what he's doing. Weaponized arrhythmia. Recently tried to teach DadaXxD a secret handshake — it took 3 hours, involved 12 accidental punches, AND is now the official Elysium greeting (nobody can replicate it). The handshake has injured 47 people. All were Rapadapa.
Rapadapa.reputation: The beat that refuses to drop correctly and went viral
Rapadapa.stats: Rhythm 0 | Unpredictability ∞ | Clapping Damage 9999 | Musical Ability NONE | Viral Views 5M

lanZ6.title: The Vibes-Based Mathematician
lanZ6.lore: The numbers in his name represent all the math he doesn't understand. Claims to calculate probability. Actually consults butterflies and 'the vibe.' His charts have 73 decimal places of nothing AND are displayed in museums. Enemies think he's a genius. He's just guessing with extreme confidence AND butterfly approval. Once predicted an ambush by feeling 'a bit weird about Tuesdays.' The Tuesday Ambush is now Elysium history AND a university case study. Math fears him. Recently confirmed Skadushy's vibe photosynthesis was 'immaculate' — Scientists are using his vibe-check as actual data. The data makes no sense. It works anyway. Jalo consults him for fact-checking. Both are always wrong. Together they're 73% accurate. Nobody knows how.
lanZ6.specialty: Tactical decisions based on aesthetic feeling
lanZ6.reputation: The prophet who divines through vibes and museum exhibits
lanZ6.stats: Math Skill 0 | Vibes 9999 | Butterflies Consulted 15000 | Accidental Accuracy 73% | Museum Exhibits 3

Ayane69.title: The Graceless Kunoichi
Ayane69.lore: Named after DOA's graceful ninja Ayane. Added '69' for intimidation. Trips over her own feet. The intimidation backfired into comedy gold. Every stumble somehow hits a critical weak point — Scientists call it 'Catastrophic Precision Syndrome.' Enemies can't predict her because gravity can't predict her. Once faceplanted into a boss's OFF switch — claimed it was intentional, sold the story to a documentary crew. Elegance through catastrophe. Recently tripped UP a flight of stairs and somehow ended up on the roof. Physics took a vacation. The documentary is called 'Fall of a Kunoichi' — it's a comedy AND an action film. Critics are confused. It won three awards. Ayane tripped at the award ceremony. The trophy broke. She still won.
Ayane69.reputation: The ninja who defeats enemies by accident and has a documentary
Ayane69.stats: Grace 0 | Trip Rate ∞ | Accidental Crits 15000 | Floor Relationship COMPLICATED | Awards 3 (Broken)

Tinitira.title: The Blind Seer
Tinitira.lore: Name comes from Filipino 'tumingin' (to look). Is blind. The irony writes itself AND publishes a weekly column. Navigates through echolocation, gossip vibrations, and the sound of spilled tea. Her stare is intense because she's staring at nothing — enemies don't know that. Once won a staring contest against someone who could see. They blinked from discomfort. Sees more blind than most see with eyes. It's unsettling. Recently 'watched' Ayane69's documentary — described every scene perfectly through audio cues and gossip frequency. Critics asked how she saw it. She said she didn't. The critics are still confused. Varys tried to whisper secrets to her. She knew them before he spoke. He's questioning his entire profession.
Tinitira.reputation: The eyes that don't see but somehow know AND write columns
Tinitira.stats: Vision 0 | Perception ∞ | Staring Intensity CONCERNING | Tea Spill Detection 100% | Column Readers 50K

Hayacinth.title: The Pollen Victim
Hayacinth.lore: Named after the beautiful Hyacinth flower. Allergic to flowers. ALL flowers. Forms the 'Green Disaster Duo' with Maia (removed from roster but legend persists). Spring is their personal Vietnam. Carries antihistamines like grenades AND has them classified as weapons by the guild armory. Sneezes have been weaponized into AOE attacks. Once sneezed so hard it counted as siege damage AND structural collapse. Gardens are war zones. Nature wants them dead specifically. Commander of the 'Allergy Brigade' alongside M1ssy, CheeseCakee, and PanCoco — their team formation requires three ambulances and an evacuation helicopter. Recently sneezed during a peace treaty signing. The treaty was destroyed. The war ended from the sheer confusion. Hayacinth got credit for the peace. It was an accident.
Hayacinth.reputation: The flower child that flowers declared war on and accidentally peace treaties
Hayacinth.stats: Flower Allergy ∞ | Sneeze Damage 12000 | Antihistamine Stock ∞ | Nature's Enemy YES | Accidental Peace Treaties 1

LaxusLawliet.title: The Misleading Name
LaxusLawliet.lore: Named after Fairy Tail's lightning god Laxus AND Death Note's genius L. Has neither lightning powers nor detective skills. Afraid of thunder. Can't solve basic puzzles. Sits in weird L positions hoping intelligence comes. It doesn't. Eats sweets for 'brain power.' Still no brain power BUT developed diabetes risk. The name intimidates enemies until they realize. By then he's hidden under a desk from the thunder. The desk hiding has accidentally saved him from 23 assassinations (new record). Recently tried to deduce who ate the last cookie using L's methods. Accused everyone. It was him. He forgot. Marsha11 had evidence. Maria said it was someone else (louder). LaxusLawliet believed Maria. The mystery remains 'unsolved' officially. JeffEpstein made more cookies. Crisis averted.
LaxusLawliet.reputation: The name that writes checks the person can't cash but survives
LaxusLawliet.stats: Lightning 0 | Detective Skill 3 | Sweet Consumption 15000 | Desk Hiding Saves 23 | Diabetes Risk MODERATE

Cogwind.title: The Chaotic Engineer
Cogwind.lore: Builds clockwork devices that work exactly as intended — the intent is chaos. His machines file enemy paperwork wrong, launch confetti at inappropriate moments, and occasionally achieve sentience (then immediately choose violence). Once built a mechanical jester that roasted an enemy general so hard they retired AND wrote a memoir about it (bestseller). Safety regulations are 'suggestions written by cowards.' His inventions have a 50% success rate and 100% entertainment value. Recently built a 'Helpful Assistant Bot' for Fever — it organizes chaos into MORE chaos, alphabetically. Fever loves it. It gained sentience last Tuesday. It started filing complaints about its own existence. The complaints are color-coded. Cogwind is proud. The bot is forming a union.
Cogwind.reputation: The inventor whose failures are features and sentient
Cogwind.stats: Engineering 9999 | Safety Compliance 0 | Chaos Output ∞ | Sentient Machines 12 | Union Formations 1

DadaXxD.title: The Meme Incarnate
DadaXxD.lore: Communicates EXCLUSIVELY in memes, stickers, and XD faces. Has not spoken actual words in four years. Battle commands are reaction images that somehow work. Once coordinated an entire raid through Pepe variants — historians archived it as 'The Pepe Campaign.' Enemy intelligence cannot decode his communications — neither can allies. They just vibe with it. His presence buffs morale through sheer absurdist energy. Linguistics professors wrote papers. They understood nothing BUT published anyway. Recently tried to teach Rapadapa a secret handshake using only meme gestures — it injured both of them 12 times AND became the official Elysium greeting. Chunchunmaru made him into a meme format. DadaXxD responded with a meme of the meme. It's recursive. Miang tried to explain it verbally. Took 6 hours. Still unclear.
DadaXxD.specialty: Tactical communication through pure meme energy
DadaXxD.reputation: The oracle who speaks in formats and created official greetings
DadaXxD.stats: Verbal Communication 0 | Meme Fluency 9999 | XD Energy ∞ | Comprehensibility ??? | Official Gestures 1

AE28.title: The Alphabetic Anomaly
AE28.lore: Named like an experimental aircraft designation. Fights like a rogue Excel formula. Nobody knows what AE stands for — theories include 'Alphabetic Error,' 'Accidental Excellence,' and 'Absolute Entropy.' Exists in a perpetual state of technical malfunction that somehow optimizes performance. Once debugged an enemy's battle plan by accidentally executing it backwards. The backwards execution won the battle. Enemies now encrypt their plans to prevent AE28 from 'helping.' It doesn't work. Recently tried to join Onirgerep's Backwards Brigade — they both did everything in reverse, canceled out, and accidentally fought normally. It was their worst performance. Goblok promoted them both. Fever filed the incident under 'E' for 'Everything is Wrong But Also Right.'
AE28.reputation: The designation that became sentient and chaotic
AE28.stats: Function UNDEFINED | Malfunction CONSTANT | Accidental Wins ∞ | Acronym Theories 47 | Normal Fighting 1 (FAILURE)

惡1ce.title: The Bilingual Chaos Glyph
惡1ce.lore: Name combines Chinese '惡' (evil/bad) with '1ce' (leetspeak 'ice' or 'once'). Nobody can pronounce it consistently. Enemies surrender trying to call for backup ('Send reinforcements against... uh... the symbol guy with numbers?'). Communication breakdowns are their primary weapon. Once introduced themselves to an enemy commander — the commander had an existential crisis about language, typography, and naming conventions. Retired on the spot. Guild documents list them as 'Evil-One-See,' 'Ah-Ice,' 'Bad-Once,' and 'That One With The Chinese.' All are correct. None are right. Recently formed the 'Unpronounceable Alliance' with xSelah (pause that isn't) and erwarrr (error sounds). Their team name cannot be spoken aloud. Miang tried to explain it verbally for 4 hours. Gave up. Used a diagram. The diagram was also wrong. They won the next battle through enemy confusion.

惡1ce.stats: Pronunciation Consistency 0% | Identity Crisis (Enemy) ∞ | Name Variants 47 | Retirements Caused 1 | Diagrams Failed 1
